raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

SWA matching excludes `swa_reprefill_tail_tokens(req)` before page alignment,
but out-of-window eviction currently retains the window behind the untrimmed
frontier. At some alignments it frees a page needed behind the actual match
boundary. An otherwise reusable Full-KV prefix then falls back to an older SWA
checkpoint and unnecessarily re-prefills almost an entire 8K chunk.

With 256-token pages, a 128-token window/replay guard and a 32,576-token prefix,
the old frontier frees through position 32,256. The matched prefix needs the
preceding window too; retaining through 32,000 avoids that fallback. A
32,448-token prefix is the unaffected alignment control.

## Modifications

- Pass the existing replay-tail policy through the KV-storage `advance` API
  from both scheduler allocation and unified-cache checkpoints. Both the arena
  and static storage implementations forward it to the shared SWA helper.
- Retain the window behind the earlier, aligned replay boundary when prefix
  sharing is enabled. Keep the replay guard and attention kernels unchanged.
- Preserve checkpoint floors, previously freed cursors, and the no-replay and
  no-prefix-sharing policies.
- Add nine CPU-registered regressions executing the real helper, including an
  alignment sweep and the two caller policies. For the 256/128/128 configuration
  above, the extra retention is at most one page.

## Accuracy Tests

Ported to main `2ccbdab65fb1` through the KV-storage refactor. All nine
replay-retention tests and both existing eviction-interval tests pass using the
pinned serving image as the CPU dependency environment:

```sh
PYTHONPATH=python python test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_swa_replay_retention.py
```

Earlier paired GPU serving tests used DeepSeek V4.1 Flash MXFP4, TP2, SM120,
8K chunks, and SGLang `ed0b8f433f88` plus the dual-EPYC integration recipe:

| Prefix | Original first replay: recomputed / elapsed | Fixed first replay |
|---|---|---|
| 32,576 tokens | 8,000 / 9.03-9.13 s | 320 / 2.87-2.88 s |
| 32,448 tokens | 192 / 2.28-2.29 s | 192 / 2.28-2.29 s |

Two cache-isolated trials per length passed. A frozen 269,913-token tool-history
fixture also returned the correct superseding facts fresh and on three cached
replays: 345 tokens recomputed instead of 5,977, with 3.38-second first-replay
TTFT. Those are bounded serving checks, not general agent-quality qualification.
The corresponding fix also passed a later serving qualification on SGLang
`20036b7add8c` plus recipe `6dcdf640065c`: two independent near-1M histories,
four concurrent sessions in a 3M pool, updated tool evidence, cancellation,
queueing and eviction recovery (32 reasoning-enabled fact checks, zero
retractions). That validates the integrated deployment; GPU inference has not
been rerun on this clean `2ccbdab65fb1` main port.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

On the matched deployed stack, single-request decode was 23.76 before / 23.86
tok/s after; four-request aggregate decode was 29.89 / 29.73 tok/s. Differences
are below 1%; no decode improvement is claimed. Cold prefill stayed unchanged.
The intended improvement is avoiding unnecessary first-replay recomputation.

## Checklist

- [x] Added registered CPU unit tests.
- [x] Checked formatting, imports, selected lint rules and whitespace.
- [x] Documented measured accuracy/performance scope and current-main GPU limitation.
- [x] No new setting or user-facing API; no separate documentation change needed.

nodes.body:
Updated against main `2ccbdab65fb1`, resolving the KV-storage refactor conflict without changing the retention policy. Both `KVStorage.advance` and `StaticKVStorage.advance` now forward the replay guard from scheduler allocation and unified-cache checkpoints.

Nine replay-retention tests and both existing eviction-interval tests pass in the pinned CPU dependency environment; formatting, compilation and the PR diff's whitespace checks pass. The PR body distinguishes clean-main CPU validation from the integrated TP2 near-1M/four-session serving qualification.

Upstream lint passed. The automated test gates currently stop at `Require run-ci label (optional)` with `Missing required label 'run-ci'`; they have not executed the tests. Could a maintainer enable CI when ready for review?

An independent reproduction of this bug, at SGLang `3edea93cbc`, on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 MXFP4 with KTransformers. The setup was TP2 on 2× RTX 5070 Ti, page size 256, a 128-token window, and decoder SWA bounded replay on.

A 32,625-token prompt was sent, the request generated G tokens, and the bare prompt was sent again:

| | G = 1 | G = 2 to 512 |
|---|---|---|
| main at `3edea93cbc` | 32,256 cached (369 recomputed) | 16,384 cached (16,241 recomputed) |
| `SGLANG_OPT_UNIFIED_CACHE_FREE_OUT_OF_WINDOW_SLOTS=0` | 32,256 | 32,256 |
| checkpoint frontier minus the replay tail (below) | 32,256 | 32,256 |

HiCache on or off gave the same numbers. In a seeded multi-session check, four sessions of 786K, 131K, 65K and 33K tokens were answered and then replayed together. Their first replay recomputed 3,079-16,241 tokens a session before the change and 263-369 after.

The change we tested touches only the two pre-insert frees in `UnifiedRadixCache` (`checkpoint_into_tree` and `advance_unpublished_req`):

```python
comp.free_out_of_window_slots(
    req,
    len(radix_key) - 1 - self.swa_reprefill_tail_tokens(req),
    insert_params,
)
```

This PR also covers the scheduler-allocation path, which the change above does not. We have not run this PR's branch itself.

+"""Exercise SWA eviction frontiers without accelerator execution or model weights."""
+
+import ast
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache import common as cache_common
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class ReplayRetentionTest(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.source = Path(cache_common.__file__).parent
+        cls.free_window = staticmethod(cache_common.free_swa_out_of_window_slots)
+
+    def frontier(
+        self,
+        length,
+        window=128,
+        page=256,
+        replay=128,
+        sharing=True,
+        retain_floor=None,
+        previous=0,
+    ):
+        kv = SimpleNamespace(
+            holds_kv=True,
+            cache_protected_len=0,
+            req_pool_idx=0,
+            swa_dead_lo=lambda _: 0,
+            get_evicted_seqlen=lambda _: previous,
+        )
+        kv.set_evicted_seqlen = lambda _, value: setattr(kv, "evicted", value)
+        table = Mock()
+        table.__getitem__ = Mock(return_value=object())
+        allocator = SimpleNamespace(free_swa_segment=Mock())
+        self.free_window(
+            SimpleNamespace(kv=kv),
+            length - 1,
+            sliding_window_size=window,
+            page_size=page,
+            req_to_token_pool=SimpleNamespace(req_to_token=table),
+            token_to_kv_pool_allocator=allocator,
+            supports_prefix_sharing=sharing,
+            retain_floor=retain_floor,
+            reprefill_tail_tokens=replay,
+        )
+        return kv.evicted
+
+    def test_first_replay_keeps_window_before_trimmed_match(self):
+        for length in (32576, 32448, 269913, 1029986):
+            with self.subTest(length=length):
+                boundary = (length - 128) // 256 * 256
+                self.assertLessEqual(self.frontier(length), boundary - 128)
+
+    def test_all_page_alignments_preserve_replay_history(self):
+        for page, window, replay in (
+            (256, 128, 128),
+            (64, 128, 128),
+            (16, 8, 8),
+            (1, 4, 4),
+        ):
+            for remainder in range(page):
+                length = 64 * page + 2 * window + remainder
+                with self.subTest(page=page, window=window, remainder=remainder):
+                    boundary = (length - replay) // page * page
+                    self.assertLessEqual(
+                        self.frontier(length, window, page, replay), boundary - window
+                    )
+
+    def test_no_replay_keeps_existing_eviction_policy(self):
+        for length in range(32000, 32512):
+            expected = (length - 1 - 256) // 256 * 256
+            self.assertEqual(self.frontier(length, replay=0), expected)
+
+    def test_256_token_pages_retain_at_most_one_extra_page(self):
+        for length in range(32000, 32512):
+            before = self.frontier(length, replay=0)
+            after = self.frontier(length)
+            self.assertGreaterEqual(before - after, 0)
+            self.assertLessEqual(before - after, 256)
+
+    def test_bad_alignment_exposes_original_frontier_mismatch(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self.frontier(32576, replay=0), 32256)
+        self.assertEqual(self.frontier(32576), 32000)
+        self.assertEqual(self.frontier(32448), 32000)
+
+    def test_disabled_prefix_sharing_does_not_retain_replay_history(self):
+        for replay in (0, 128):
+            self.assertEqual(self.frontier(32576, replay=replay, sharing=False), 32256)
+
+    def test_checkpoint_floor_and_eviction_cursor_still_apply(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self.frontier(32576, retain_floor=30000), 29952)
+        # Previously freed slots cannot be recovered by changing a frontier.
+        self.assertEqual(self.frontier(32576, previous=32256), 32256)
+
+    def test_scheduler_and_checkpoint_paths_pass_the_replay_guard(self):
+        for relative, expected in (
+            ("allocation.py", "tree_cache.swa_reprefill_tail_tokens(req)"),
+            (
+                "unified_cache/components/swa.py",
+                "self.cache.swa_reprefill_tail_tokens(req)",
+            ),
+        ):
+            tree = ast.parse((self.source / relative).read_text())
+            calls = [
+                node
+                for node in ast.walk(tree)
+                if isinstance(node, ast.Call)
+                and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute)
+                and node.func.attr == "advance"
+            ]
+            self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
+            keyword = next(
+                (kw for kw in calls[0].keywords if kw.arg == "reprefill_tail_tokens"),
+                None,
+            )
+            self.assertIsNotNone(keyword, relative)
+            self.assertEqual(ast.unparse(keyword.value), expected)
+
+    def test_storage_implementations_forward_the_replay_guard(self):
+        for relative in ("kv/storage.py", "static_kv_storage.py"):
+            tree = ast.parse((self.source / relative).read_text())
+            method = next(
+                node
+                for node in ast.walk(tree)
+                if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "advance"
+            )
+            # Execute the real method with a recording eviction primitive.
+            method.body = [
+                node for node in method.body if not isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom)
+            ]
+            module = ast.Module(
+                body=[
+                    ast.ImportFrom(
+                        module="__future__",
+                        names=[ast.alias(name="annotations")],
+                        level=0,
+                    ),
+                    method,
+                ],
+                type_ignores=[],
+            )
+            free_window = Mock()
+            scope = {"free_swa_out_of_window_slots": free_window}
+            exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(module), relative, "exec"), scope)
+            storage = SimpleNamespace(
+                _allocator=SimpleNamespace(page_size=256), requests=object()
+            )
+            scope["advance"](
+                storage,
+                object(),
+                32575,
+                window=128,
+                retain_floor=None,
+                shares_prefixes=True,
+                reprefill_tail_tokens=128,
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(free_window.call_args.kwargs["reprefill_tail_tokens"], 128)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
